scaling_metadata.generator_python:
import os,json,re,subprocess,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/tmp/plum-blocks-scale');root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
rows=[]
for kind in ('expr','let','assign'):
 for width in (128,256,512,1024):
  project=root/f'{kind}-{width}';project.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  prefix='let identity(s: String): String = s\nlet observe(s: String): Unit = assert_eq(s,"41-shared")\n'
  if kind=='expr':body='observe(s);\n'*width
  elif kind=='let':body=''.join(f'let x{i} = identity(s);\n' for i in range(width))+f'assert_eq(x0,s); assert_eq(x{width-1},s);\n'
  else:body='let mut current=s;\n'+'current={ let temporary=identity(current); temporary };\n'*width+'assert_eq(current,s);\n'
  source=prefix+'let visit(s: String): Unit = {\n'+body+'}\nlet main(): Unit = { visit(41.to_string().concat("-shared")); println("ok") }\n'
  (project/'main.plum').write_text(source)
  for label,compiler in [('before','/tmp/plum-blocks-baseline'),('after','/tmp/plum-blocks-ci')]:
   for mode,flags in [('debug',[]),('release',['--release'])]:
    r=subprocess.run([compiler,'emit-llvm',str(project),*flags],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PLUM_RT_STATS='1'),timeout=180)
    if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(r.stdout[-2000:]+r.stderr[-2000:])
    (root/f'{kind}-{width}-{label}-{mode}.ll').write_bytes(r.stdout)
    stats=re.search(rb'alloc n=(\d+) bytes=(\d+)',r.stderr)
    row=dict(kind=kind,width=width,label=label,mode=mode,allocations=int(stats[1]),allocated_bytes=int(stats[2]),ir_bytes=len(r.stdout),source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),stdout_sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest())
    rows.append(row);print(row,flush=True)
(root/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
